No bus stop there: click one of the orange marks
column2: 該處沒有巴士站：點擊其中一個橙色標記

column1: The roads can't be read without the OMSI 2 folder.
column2: 沒有 OMSI 2 資料夾就無法讀取道路。

column1: A line needs at least two bus stops on the map: place them with Game logic > Bus stops, beside a road.
column2: 一條路線至少需要地圖上兩個巴士站：用「遊戲邏輯 > 巴士站」在路邊放置。

column1: Pick a line on the left, or make a new one.
column2: 在左側選擇一條路線，或新增一條。

column1: A line has trips (a way from stop to stop) and tours (one bus's day: which trip it drives when).
column2: 路線有班次（由站到站的路徑）及行車週期（一架巴士的一天：何時執行哪個班次）。

column1: That name is taken or can't be a file name
column2: 該名稱已被使用或不能作為檔名

column1: A copy of the line with its trips and tours (a variant to change)
column2: 複製該路線及其班次與行車週期（以改動的變體）

column1: Delete the line and its trips
A tour is one bus's day: the trips it drives, one after the other, and when each leaves.
column2: 行車週期是一架巴士的一天：它依次執行哪些班次，以及每班何時出發。

column1: A trip is one way along the line: its stops in order. Most lines have two, there and back.
column2: 班次是沿路線的一程：依序經過各站。大多數路線有兩程，去程與回程。

column1: A new trip with the same stops the other way round
column2: 以相同車站但相反方向建立的新班次

column1: This trip runs on a track of its own (a train): its stops are kept as they are.
column2: 此班次行駛於自己的軌道（列車）：其車站保持不變。

column1: Click the stops in the view one after the other, in the order the bus calls at them
column2: 依巴士停靠順序，在畫面中逐一點擊車站

column1: Click stops on the map (they are marked orange)…
column2: 點擊地圖上的車站（以橙色標示）…

column1: Add two stops or more: the way between them is found along the roads.
column2: 新增兩個或以上的車站：其間的路徑會沿道路尋找。

column1: km along the roads (blue in the view)
column2: 公里（沿道路，於畫面中以藍色顯示）

column1: the way drives a one-way lane against its direction; is a path drawn the wrong way round?
column2: 該路徑在單程路上逆行；該路徑是否畫反了方向？

column1: no road with car lanes within 15 m
column2: 15 米內沒有可行車的道路

column1: the roads are not joined, or run the other way (see View > AI lanes)
column2: 道路未接合，或方向相反（見「檢視 > AI 行車線」）

column1: The trip is saved, but its way is not until this is mended
column2: 班次已儲存，但其路徑要待此問題修正後才會生效

column1: From the route's length at the pace of a town bus
column2: 按市區巴士的速度由路徑長度估算

column1: Minutes after the trip leaves. They follow the distance between the stops; fix one to keep the bus to it (it waits there when early).
column2: 班次出發後的 分鐘數。按各站之間的距離而定；固定其中一個可讓巴士準時（提早到達時會在該站等候）。

column1: On a public holiday only the tours with Holidays ticked run; school holidays pick the tours for school holidays or school days.
column2: 公眾假期只行駛勾選了「假期」的行車週期；學校假期則選取學校假期或上課日的行車週期。

column1: The same days a year later (feasts that move, like Easter, are to be set by hand)
column2: 一年後的相同日子（會移動的節日如復活節須人手設定）

column1: The map has no depot (ailists.cfg): only you drive these tours, no AI buses.
column2: 地圖沒有車廠（ailists.cfg）：這些行車週期只有你可駕駛，沒有 AI 巴士。

column1: Add a depot with OMSI 2's MAN buses
column2: 新增載有 OMSI 2 MAN 巴士的車廠

column1: Its buses run the tours (Map > Traffic and AI shows it)
column2: 其巴士執行行車週期（見「地圖 > 交通與 AI」）

column1: Pick a tour to see its departures.
column2: 選擇一個行車週期以查看其出發時間。

column1: The next trip of the line, when the bus is back and has had its break
column2: 該路線的下一班次，巴士返回並休息後

column1: Replace the tour's departures: the line's trips one after the other, a break after each
column2: 取代行車週期的出發時間：依序填入路線的各班次，每班之後休息

column1: No departures yet: add them above.
column2: 尚未有出發時間：請在上方新增。

column1: The AI's vehicles come in groups. A car group drives about on the roads; a depot sends out the buses of the timetable's tours.
column2: AI 的車輛以群組形式出現。汽車群組在道路上遊走；車廠則派出時間表內行車週期的巴士。

column1: (This map's ailists.cfg is in OMSI 2's first format: it is written in the second one when changed.)
column2: （此地圖的 ailists.cfg 為 OMSI 2 的第一種格式：變更後會以第二種格式寫出。）

column1: is to drive about, but there is no such group.
column2: 打算遊走，但並無此群組。
以 OMSI 2 的車輛建立

column1: The group of that name from OMSI 2's own maps
column2: 同名群組，來自 OMSI 2 本身的地圖

column1: Pick a group on the left.
Delete the group (tours still take their buses from it)
column2: 刪除群組（行車週期仍從中取用巴士）

column1: Tours that take their buses from here:
column2: 從此處取用巴士的行車週期：

column1: Times the traffic over the day
A vehicle with more weight comes along more often.
column2: 權重愈大的車輛出現愈頻密。

column1: None of its buses has this depot file beside it: they run without their destination signs and fleet data.
column2: 其巴士旁都沒有這個車廠檔案：它們會在沒有終點顯示牌及車隊資料下行駛。

column1: The buses it has: a type of bus and the fleet number and plate of each.
column2: 其擁有的巴士：巴士類型，以及每架的車隊編號與車牌。

column1: The lists can't be read without the OMSI 2 folder.
column2: 沒有 OMSI 2 資料夾就無法讀取這些清單。

column1: What stands on the car parks (Game logic > Car parks). A car listed more often stands there more often.
column2: 停放在停車場上的車輛（「遊戲邏輯 > 停車場」）。列出次數愈多的汽車，停放出現的次數也愈多。

column1: Who walks about and waits at the stops.
column2: 四處步行及在車站等候的人。
駕駛 AI 巴士的人。

column1: How often it is listed (0 takes it out)
column2: 列出的頻率（0 表示移除）

column1: How busy the map is at each hour: the road traffic, and the passengers at the stops. 1 is normal; the game goes along the line between the points.
column2: 地圖在各時段的繁忙程度：道路交通及車站候車人數。1 為正常；遊戲會沿各點之間的線段取值。

column1: Its own traffic over the day
Without one the group follows the map's road traffic. A curve can be for some days of the week only.
column2: 沒有自訂曲線時，群組會跟隨地圖的道路交通。曲線亦可只適用於每週的特定日子。

column1: The map has no depot file.
The map has no trips yet (Map > Lines and timetable)
column2: 地圖尚未有班次（「地圖 > 路線與時間表」）

column1: A new depot file from the map's lines
column2: 由地圖路線建立的新車廠檔案

column1: What is there stays as it is
The AI's depot groups (Vehicle groups tab) take their buses' destinations from it
column2: AI 的車廠群組（車輛群組分頁）從中取得巴士的終點

column1: The destination a bus shows on its way to and from the depot
column2: 巴士往返車廠途中所顯示的終點
另一個終點已有此代碼

column1: As a trip's terminus is named in the timetable: the stop where everybody gets off
column2: 如班次終點在時間表中所命名：所有乘客下車的車站

column1: Nobody gets on (service trip, empty sign)
column2: 無人上車（服務班次，顯示牌空白）

column1: As the timetable names the stop
column2: 如時間表所命名的車站

column1: What the driver types: the line's number and two digits (7601: line 76, route 01)
column2: 司機所輸入的內容：路線號碼加兩位數字（7601：路線 76，路線 01）

column1: Not in the Stops list: the displays have no texts for it
column2: 不在車站清單中：顯示屏沒有其文字

column1: No routes: the IBIS knows the destinations' codes only. Add them from the lines above.
column2: 沒有路線：IBIS 只知道終點的代碼。請從上方的路線新增。

column2: 如 openstreetmap.org 所繪的地圖（附名稱的街道、房屋、水域、綠地、停車標誌），由 OpenStreetMap 資料清晰繪製，鋪在 Tile 上取代衛星圖片：以便憑肉眼在其上建造道路與房屋。它不會由此產生任何內容。

column1: Place the map on the Earth first.
column2: 請先將地圖定位到地球。

column1: The picture is on the tiles: line it up in Satellite and terrain, Own pictures.
column2: 圖片已在 Tile 上：在「衛星與地形 > 自備圖片」中對齊。

column1: Some tiles had Google imagery: enter your Google key to see it again (it is not kept with the map).
column2: 部分 Tile 有 Google 影像：輸入你的 Google 金鑰即可再次查看（不隨地圖儲存）。

column2: 點擊地圖上橙色 Tile 應放置的位置…

column2: 然後點擊地圖：橙色 Tile 的中間會置於該處

column2: 點擊地圖以在畫面中飛往該處

column1: 1. Find the place.  2. Press "Place the map here" and click on the map: the orange tile (the map's middle) goes there.
column2: 1. 尋找地點。 2. 按「將地圖放在此處」並點擊地圖：橙色 Tile（地圖的中間）會置於該處。
